instruction.text: Look at the example sentence below and fill in the following gaps about the future perfect.

atoms.a: She will have eaten by the time we arrive
atoms.b: The future perfect tense shows that an action will be completed in the ((past present ++future)).
To form the future perfect tense, you need the helping verbs ((++will_+_have had_+_has)) and the past participle form of a verb.
atoms.sound: To form the future perfect tense, you need the helping verbs, will, have and the past participle form of a verb.

instruction.text: What is the correct future perfect tense formula? Fill in the gaps.
Match the verbs with their past participle forms.
Fill in the gaps with the future perfect tense of the verb.

hint.text:
Remember: to form the future perfect tense you need the helping verbs will + have + the past participle form of a verb.

For example:
She will have done the work.
hint.sound: Remember: to form the future perfect tense you need the helping verbs, will, have, and the past participle form of a verb. For example: She will have done the work.

atoms.b: I ((will_have_thought)) about your suggestion by the next time we see each other.
By tonight, she ((will_have_returned)) my skateboard to me.
Hopefully after their upcoming talk, they ((will_have_forgiven)) each other.
The storm ((will_have_blown)) all fragile things away if it gets terribly windy.
This time next week, our journey to the Amazon River ((will_have_begun)).
